heading: Built for businesses that already have something good.
intro: I work best with businesses that already have something people want, and need it to look, work or reach better. Scope and timeline are agreed before anything starts, so there are no surprises halfway through.

smallLine: Full software and apps are quoted on their own after a short call.
teardownTitle: Not ready to commit? Get a free walkthrough.
teardownBody: Send me your website, your Instagram or one of your ads. I'll record a short video going through it the way a new customer would, and show you the first three things I'd change. It's free, and the video is yours either way.

faq.q: How does a project actually run?
faq.a: Once we agree on scope, we split the work into two payments: one to start and one at the end. I set up a shared Slack or WhatsApp channel so we can talk directly. You'll see real progress within the first few days, and from there we review, refine and keep going until it feels right.

faq.q: Do you write the copy as well?
faq.a: Yes. Words and design are done together, because one without the other doesn't work. If you already have copy you love, I'll design around it.

Whatever fits the job. Framer for most websites, because it's fast and your team can edit it without me. Webflow if you're already on it. Custom code with Next.js for software, dashboards, AI tools and anything that needs to do more than look good.

faq.q: Can my team edit things after you're done?
faq.a: That's the plan. Everything is set up with clean components and a simple CMS where it makes sense, so changing a headline doesn't need a designer.

faq.q: Do you only work with coaching programs?
faq.a: No. I've worked with coaching programs, AI startups, an edtech company, events and local businesses, and I build tools for my own team too. If you sell something online, I can probably help.

faq.q: You're in Karachi. How does that work with time zones?
faq.a: I overlap with UK, Europe and Gulf working hours every day and work with US clients too. I'm reachable on WhatsApp most of the time, and a lot of clients like waking up to progress.

faq.q: What if I already have a designer?
faq.a: Then I can work alongside them on the parts that need more attention, like the funnel, the forms or a custom tool. Good designers usually like having another good designer around.
You deal with me from start to finish. For bigger builds I bring in the Xtarc team, and I stay your one point of contact.
